# Rasniki adaptable edition

Version 0.1 · Enable, disable, emable, aemdisable

This edition interprets the author's requested “max adisable max able max aemdisable emable” as broad user control over which material is shown and how it is read. These terms have no supplied formal definition, so the interpretation is provisional and AI-assisted. “Max” states an aspiration, not a claim of universal accessibility or unlimited capability.

## Proposed vocabulary

| Term | Working meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Able | A section is available for use. |
| Adisable | A section can be turned off by the reader. |
| Emable | Re-enable a section or restore a useful reading configuration. |
| Aemdisable | Suspend a section without deleting its source or changing another reader's edition. |

## Implemented controls

Open adaptable.html in a browser. Enable or disable the lore, dictionary, ashram, steadings, kerot architecture, makkakah practices, bookwriting, existential lair, and jurisdiction guidance independently. Enable all shows every section. Disable all hides the content sections while keeping navigation and controls available. Reset restores the initial edition and reading settings.

Choose a standard or larger type size, comfortable or spacious line spacing, and a dark or light high-contrast palette. These settings work locally in the current page. Nothing is uploaded or saved between page loads. Native buttons, labels, checkboxes, focus indicators, and a status announcement support keyboard and assistive-technology use; no screen-reader or comprehensive accessibility audit has been performed.

## Boundaries

The collection revision also adds independently selectable sections for manuals and Ostar planning, systematics, Archangel management, the lair game, I/O and IObot, search and math, and the ACGI catalogue. Their links open the detailed tools; toggling a section changes only this reader's visibility.

Disabling a section changes its visibility here, not the underlying publication, legal duties, permissions, device state, or another person's choices. The jurisdiction tool remains unreviewed and cannot certify legal validity. The kerot, Magrigal, and browser architecture remains a proposal. Fictional thaumaturgy has no asserted supernatural effect.

Each enabled section includes a summary and links to the existing source edition. This is a configurable reading surface for the collection, not a full replacement for its detailed source documents. Future adaptations can add verified translations, alternate input methods, or other accessibility improvements after their requirements are established.
